comments.body: I just posted up a newer version to show case cloaking and a few other items. Cloaking is not yet in the tutorial.  Atm if u choose proving grounds -> destroyer/cruiser -> press 1. U cloak.  U can fire torpedoes only in cloak.  But be careful if they spot u, ur shield’s r down while cloaked.
